class_config.description: ORGANIC #542 — Register-mapped peripheral IP: SW-visible register map (hjson/regmap or equivalent) exposed via a bus subordinate interface (TL-UL, APB, AXI-Lite, Wishbone, AHB). No ISA / instruction-fetch semantics. L4 register map is the primary specification layer. Distinguished from bus_interconnect_protocol (wire-level protocol spec) and processor_cpu (instruction-executing). crypto_accelerator takes priority when crypto algorithm features are present.
